cases.title: WordCount map tasks killed after retries

groundTruth.cause: One cluster node was disconnected from the network, so tasks could not reach HDFS datanodes on it (NoRouteToHost) to read their input blocks and were killed after retries.
goodNextSteps: Check network connectivity to the datanode address in the errors (ping, routes, switch port, firewall)
Check the HDFS datanode report for dead or unreachable nodes

answer.summary: MapReduce tasks failed due to network connectivity issues, either from a lost route to DataNodes or an IP address change on a node, both leading to NoRouteToHostException and task termination after retries. The root cause is likely one of these two network-level events, with the latter being more likely due to the specific address change log and its timing with the failure pattern.
